title: No Country for Old Men
author: Cormac McCarthy
summary: A hunter in West Texas comes across a failed drug deal and takes a case of money. A relentless killer follows his trail while an ageing sheriff tries to keep up and make sense of it all.
readIf: you like a lean, grim crime story with a terrifying antagonist and sparse prose.
skipIf: you want a satisfying resolution or a lot of dialogue punctuation, because McCarthy leaves out quotation marks.

pairings.reason: The author's earlier, far more brutal and poetic western about violence on the border.
Another McCarthy book, bleaker and quieter, that shares the stripped-down style.
A more conventional, humane crime novel with a similar sense of weary professionalism.
